description: Known answers for the commit and short-code derivations of §6. Roles use the specification's own names: SND is the Sender, RCV the Receiver. Every key here is a fixture and belongs to nobody.

commit_snd_contacting.description: Flow A (§7): the Sender is the contacting party C, so commit = SHA-256('qrst-commit-v1' || SND.pub || nonce_S).

commit_rcv_contacting.description: Flow B (§8): the Receiver is the contacting party C, so commit = SHA-256('qrst-commit-v1' || RCV.pub || nonce_R).

code_with_roles_transposed.description: Derived with SND and RCV exchanged in the transcript. An implementation that produces this value has the role ordering backwards. It MUST NOT equal `code`.
